en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2001 - Sama‘ah narrated from Abu Basir, who said:

I asked Abu ‘Abd Allah (as) about a woman making up missed fasts from Month of Ramadan, and her husband compels her to break her fast.
Imam (as) said: "It is not appropriate for him to compel her to break her fast after the sun has passed its zenith."
